# Controlled benchmark v0.1 fixtures

These are small synthetic, curated-control fixtures authored and audited before benchmark
execution. Each memory is an explicit representation of its declared local transcript evidence,
and the base stores contain no intentional structural or benchmark-policy defect. This deliberate
construction is why the fixture registry may label them `CURATED_CLEAN` for the controlled defect
conditions evaluated here.

`CURATED_CLEAN` is not a claim that real deployed memory stores are globally clean. These fixtures
are controlled research inputs and are not statistically representative of natural agent-memory
systems.

Held-out means that these case contents were not used to tune checker rules, semantic models,
composition, thresholds, prompts, pair policy, or readiness gates before this freeze. It does not
prove semantic independence from every possible external corpus.

No detector outputs, benchmark results, scores, or performance tables are stored in this directory.
